goals.statement: Prepare a small hackathon prototype and a clear project walkthrough.
Review the selected organizer's published submission checklist before committing.

tasks.title: Scope and build small AI prototype using Python, React, and APIs
tasks.deliverable: Working small prototype plus brief scope note linking reported stack to chosen real-world problem or technical idea
tasks.completionCriteria: Prototype runs for demo; scope note lists problem idea, main user flow, Python/React/API components used, and AI approach considered

tasks.title: Draft clear project walkthrough for prototype
tasks.deliverable: Short walkthrough document or script with demo steps and architecture overview
tasks.completionCriteria: Walkthrough covers what was built, how Python/React/APIs connect, AI behavior observed, and how to run the demo without prior context

tasks.title: Review published submission checklist from organizer materials
tasks.deliverable: Checklist summary noting submission items, track rule, and portal location as stated in organizer materials
tasks.completionCriteria: Summary references only organizer-published checklist items; open questions listed before further commitment

tasks.title: Prepare portal submission package
tasks.deliverable: Draft submission package prepared for entry through the official event portal
tasks.completionCriteria: Package contains project details and links or files ready for portal entry; entry made only through official portal

tasks.title: Document original work and license compliance
tasks.deliverable: Originality and licensing note listing own code and any third-party code, data, or models with licenses
tasks.completionCriteria: All components marked as original or attributed with applicable license conditions noted; no unverified ownership claims

tasks.title: Select one track and align prototype
tasks.deliverable: Single-track selection note aligned to prototype scope
tasks.completionCriteria: One track recorded as selection; prototype description kept consistent with single-track entry

warnings: Tasks build on reported Python, React, and APIs experience to prepare a small prototype and walkthrough, review the organizer checklist, and address mandatory portal, original-work, and single-track requirements. AI background materials are attached only to prototype scoping where terminology and practical ML introduction are relevant; other tasks use no listed resource. Time information is incomplete so no schedule is promised.
Progress is self-reported and does not change eligibility or submission facts.
Submission timing is unconfirmed; this is untimed guidance.
Submission source coverage remains incomplete; task coverage does not establish submission completeness.
